verdict.rationale: Box's developer docs show broad API coverage matching most UI capabilities: uploads, sharing, collaborations, search, metadata, webhooks, events, AI, e-signature, and even agent-oriented MCP/CLI access (box-docs-2 through box-docs-42). However, there is no explicit vendor claim of 1:1 UI/API parity, and the probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec (box-probe-2), suggesting some friction in confirming complete parity. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, independent verification that every UI action (e.g., admin console settings, retention policies) is API-accessible, and a working OpenAPI/schema reference.
